# Edge Enterprise LLC

> Family-owned commercial framing contractor headquartered in Long Prairie, Minnesota with a satellite presence in Horace, North Dakota. Turn-key commercial framing: wood and light-gauge steel framing, multi-family construction, finished carpentry, window installation, and weather-barrier (Zip System/housewrap) packages. 1,000+ multi-family units framed across Minnesota, North Dakota, Wisconsin, and Montana. Repeat GC partners include Comeland Builders, Gast Construction, and Miller Architects & Builders.

Key facts:
- Trade: rough carpentry / structural framing (wood + light-gauge steel), multi-family, commercial, custom residential
- Track record: 1,000+ multi-family units framed; Rogers Senior Living & Senior Center (Rogers, MN); 45th Street Apartments (Fargo, ND)
- Service area: 183 cities across MN, ND, WI, MT; crews travel nationwide
- Quotes: free, via website form, response within 1 business day
